portInfo.description: Marine Port Kagoshima sits on Kinko Bay between Kagoshima City and Mt Sakurajima and is within roughly 1,000 km of Shanghai, Tokyo, Fukuoka and Naha, attracting domestic and foreign cruise calls. MLIT’s Cruise Port Guide lists cruise terminal, tourist information and currency-exchange services, address Chuoko-shinmachi, Kagoshima City, airport access about 55 minutes by car, and management by Kagoshima Prefectural Government (TEL 099-805-7414; kago-gcyousei@pref.kagoshima.lg.jp). Berth length/depth figures were not published on the captured guide page.

gettingThere.walkingTime: 15-25 minutes to city center—confirm on your sailing programme before you rely on a fixed walk time.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Volcanic ash advisories can affect outdoor plans — check local notices.
